standard_prerequisites.use: Scheme-theoretic density of quasi-compact dense opens under reduction (Morphisms of Spaces), etale-local character of relative dimension (same chapter's definition section), and the schemes propagation theorem (More on Flatness, lemma-flat-finite-presentation-dimension-over-dense-open).

core_obligations: Reduce bases so the dense open is scheme-theoretically dense.
Pass to etale scheme charts preserving density.

proof_roadmap.step: Etale descent to schemes plus the flatness-chapter theorem.

difficulty_reason: For a flat locally finite type morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S and a dense open subspace V of Y whose base change has relative dimension at most d, the lemma concludes f has relative dimension at most d provided either f is locally of finite presentation or V -> Y is quasi-compact. The retained proof is written: pass to the reduction of Y making V scheme-theoretically dense (Morphisms of Spaces, lemma-quasi-compact-immersion); note the relative-dimension bound can be checked etale locally on both sides (definition section of the chapter); take surjective etale charts of X and Y by schemes, observe the inverse image of V stays scheme-theoretically dense (hence dense), and finish with the schemes theorem (More on Flatness, lemma-flat-finite-presentation-dimension-over-dense-open). Retained author proof at lines 8603-8622.

dedup.scope: Propagation of relative dimension bounds over dense opens for flat maps of spaces.
